       COUNT(*) AS positions, COUNT(DISTINCT p.race_id) AS races,
       MIN(p.lap) AS first_lap, MAX(p.lap) AS last_lap,

JOIN main.races_ext AS r ON r.race_id = p.race_id

ORDER BY p.lap_type, r.is_pit_data_available

WITH timing AS (
    SELECT race_id, COUNT(*) AS timed_laps
    FROM main.lap_times
    GROUP BY race_id
), stops AS (
    SELECT race_id, COUNT(*) AS recorded_stops
    FROM main.pit_stops
    GROUP BY race_id
)
SELECT r.is_pit_data_available,
       MIN(r.year) AS first_timed_year,
       MAX(r.year) AS last_timed_year,
       COUNT(*) AS timed_races,
       COUNT(s.race_id) AS races_with_stops,
       SUM(t.timed_laps) AS timed_laps,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM main.retirements AS x
        JOIN main.lap_times AS l
          ON l.race_id = x.race_id AND l.driver_id = x.driver_id AND l.lap = x.lap
       ) AS timed_retirement_laps,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.drivers) AS driver_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.drivers WHERE full_name IS NULL) AS missing_driver_names
FROM main.races_ext AS r
JOIN timing AS t ON t.race_id = r.race_id
LEFT JOIN stops AS s ON s.race_id = r.race_id
GROUP BY r.is_pit_data_available
ORDER BY r.is_pit_data_available

WITH race_positions AS (
    SELECT p.race_id, p.driver_id, p.lap, COUNT(*) AS copies, MIN(p.position) AS position
    FROM main.lap_positions AS p
    JOIN main.races_ext AS r ON r.race_id = p.race_id
    WHERE p.lap_type = 'Race' AND r.is_pit_data_available = 1
    GROUP BY p.race_id, p.driver_id, p.lap
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS driver_laps,
       MAX(p.copies) AS max_copies,
       COUNT(t.position) AS matching_timed_positions,
       COUNT(x.driver_id) AS retirement_overlaps
FROM race_positions AS p
LEFT JOIN main.lap_times AS t
  ON t.race_id = p.race_id AND t.driver_id = p.driver_id AND t.lap = p.lap AND t.position = p.position
LEFT JOIN main.retirements AS x
  ON x.race_id = p.race_id AND x.driver_id = p.driver_id AND x.lap = p.lap

arguments.sql:
WITH race_positions AS (
    SELECT p.race_id, p.driver_id, p.lap, p.position
    FROM main.lap_positions AS p
    JOIN main.races_ext AS r ON r.race_id = p.race_id
    WHERE p.lap_type = 'Race'
      AND r.is_pit_data_available = 1
),
pit_laps AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap FROM main.pit_stops
    UNION
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap + 1 FROM main.pit_stops
),
on_track_laps AS (
    SELECT curr.race_id, curr.driver_id, curr.lap,
           prev.position AS previous_position,
           curr.position AS current_position
    FROM race_positions AS curr
    JOIN race_positions AS prev
      ON prev.race_id = curr.race_id
     AND prev.driver_id = curr.driver_id
     AND prev.lap = curr.lap - 1
    LEFT JOIN pit_laps AS pit
      ON pit.race_id = curr.race_id
     AND pit.driver_id = curr.driver_id
     AND pit.lap = curr.lap
    WHERE curr.lap > 1
      AND pit.driver_id IS NULL
),
overtakes AS (
    SELECT passing.driver_id AS passing_driver_id,
           passed.driver_id AS passed_driver_id
    FROM on_track_laps AS passing
    JOIN on_track_laps AS passed
      ON passed.race_id = passing.race_id
     AND passed.lap = passing.lap
     AND passing.previous_position > passed.previous_position
     AND passing.current_position < passed.current_position
),
driver_events AS (
    SELECT passed_driver_id AS driver_id, 1 AS times_overtaken, 0 AS passes_made
    FROM overtakes
    UNION ALL
    SELECT passing_driver_id, 0, 1
    FROM overtakes
)
SELECT d.full_name
FROM driver_events AS e
JOIN main.drivers AS d ON d.driver_id = e.driver_id
GROUP BY d.driver_id, d.full_name
HAVING SUM(e.times_overtaken) > SUM(e.passes_made)
ORDER BY d.full_name
LIMIT 1000

    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap FROM main.pit_stops
    UNION
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap + 1 FROM main.pit_stops
),
on_track_laps AS (
    SELECT curr.race_id, curr.driver_id, curr.lap,
           prev.position AS previous_position,
           curr.position AS current_position
    FROM race_positions AS curr
    JOIN race_positions AS prev
      ON prev.race_id = curr.race_id
     AND prev.driver_id = curr.driver_id
     AND prev.lap = curr.lap - 1
    LEFT JOIN pit_laps AS pit
      ON pit.race_id = curr.race_id
     AND pit.driver_id = curr.driver_id
     AND pit.lap = curr.lap

      AND pit.driver_id IS NULL
),
overtakes AS (
    SELECT passing.driver_id AS passing_driver_id,
           passed.driver_id AS passed_driver_id
    FROM on_track_laps AS passing
    JOIN on_track_laps AS passed
      ON passed.race_id = passing.race_id
     AND passed.lap = passing.lap
     AND passing.previous_position > passed.previous_position
     AND passing.current_position < passed.current_position
),
driver_events AS (
    SELECT passed_driver_id AS driver_id, 1 AS times_overtaken, 0 AS passes_made
    FROM overtakes
    UNION ALL
    SELECT passing_driver_id, 0, 1
    FROM overtakes
)

FROM driver_events AS e

GROUP BY d.driver_id, d.full_name

ORDER BY d.full_name
LIMIT 1000
